attributionWithoutBody.currentIndependentJudgment: The loopback tuple was sufficient for its owned server fixture. In windows eight and nine, local stylesheet-to-document attribution is directly evidenced. The actual site upload tuple, request length and terminal outcome remain unmeasured.

mandatoryLinks: Signed build, original system PNG full SHA-256 and byte count, one AppKit click and a single original product input/change with the matching full File. Bind the original operation, invocation, browser birth/window/tab, debugger target, frame, loader and document; retain the original composer and draft generation.

Capture starts before the original action. The one creation POST must be attributable to that same action on that original document. Preserve the creation request identity, actual method, response status and timing. Its own response supplies exactly one upload destination. Filename, shared origin or timing alone is insufficient.

The one subsequent PUT uses the complete destination supplied in that response. Compare the destination values before redaction, and retain only their identical SHA-256 values and permitted non-sensitive origin labels. No truncated or query-stripped comparison can establish a unique presigned destination.

Keep the initiating target/frame/loader and request-hop/redirect lineage, compatible initiator and times in the same clock domain, explicit PUT method, and a matching Content-Length from the actual request. Reject competing creates/uploads, replay, unresolved redirect, service worker ambiguity, mismatched generation, fetch from a different target or an identifier reused across sessions. The destination digest and request ID play different roles.

Record the terminal of that specific PUT hop. Distinguish an actual HTTP response and completion, a browser loading failure with a reason and no observed HTTP status, a pre-send refusal and a server rejection. A created card and durable START independently support the product observations. A creation 200 proves only the creation-endpoint result.
attributionWithoutBody.privacy: The pinned requestWillBeSentExtraInfo contract can deliver raw headers and sent or blocked associated cookies including values. Receiving complete frames in QA and discarding unwanted fields later does not establish the required no-cookie observation. The approved ordinary diagnostic path must expose only the permitted original-target fields before they cross the boundary. A custom request Content-Length column is present in pinned Chromium source. No number in that column was observed on an ordinary-window PUT.
attributionWithoutBody.withoutRequestBody: Conditionally sufficient to attribute one upload to one original product input if all listed independent links agree. Carry payloadHashUnavailable. This attribution does not prove byte-for-byte payload, actual transmitted prefix/server bytes, completed storage or visibility without their own observations.
